498(A), 504, 323, 324, r/w Section 34 of IPC, in the interest of justice and equity.
Grant such other relief as deems fit in the circumstances and in the interest of justice."
3. Earlier the petitioners had filed a petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C., which came to be dismissed as withdrawn by filing a memo.

sentences.text: 4. After filing the charge sheet petitioners are before this Court.
5. According to the complaint averments, petitioners are the father-in-law and mother-in-law of the complainant.

The marriage of complainant has taken place with only son of the petitioners and after the marriage, upto 2018 husband of the complainant has treated her well and thereafter words, he started ill treating her and therefore, she joined her matrimonial home.
6.

Subsequent thereto, on a surprise visit by the complainant, she noticed that the articles used by a lady were NC: 2024:KHC-D:5349 found in the house and on enquiry, the husband of the complainant ill treated her and assaulted her physically.
7. The said aspect of the matter has been brought to the notice of the petitioners herein.
Husband of the complainant and the petitioners have also threatened the complainant by using abusive words.

8. Subsequently, when she visited the house of petitioners, they have physically assaulted the complainant and the same has been recorded in a Video by one Ajith S/o Shamshuddin, who is the friend of the first petitioner.

The Investigating Agency have collected such evidence which are necessary, prima-facie to proceed against the petitioners herein as well for the offence punishable under Section 498-A of IPC.
9.

Therefore, it is too premature for this Court to form an opinion that the accused petitioners are innocent and therefore, no case is made out to quash the pending charge sheet against the petitioners.
Accordingly, following order is passed:
ORDER Criminal petition stands dismissed.

However, observations made by this Court during the course of this order, shall not influence the learned trial Judge and he is entitled to take independent view of the matter.
Sd/-
